basic.name: Fist of Conviction
basic.description_template: Deals Ice DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Gepard's ATK to a single enemy.

skill.name: Daunting Smite
skill.description_template: Deals Ice DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Gepard's ATK to a single enemy, with a 65% base chance to Freeze the enemy for 1 turn(s). While Frozen, the enemy cannot take action and will take Ice Additional DMG equal to {{scaling2}}% of Gepard's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

ultimate.name: Enduring Bulwark
ultimate.description_template: Applies a Shield to all allies, absorbing DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Gepard's DEF plus {{scaling2}} for 3 turn(s).

talent.name: Unyielding Will
talent.description_template: When struck with a killing blow, instead of becoming knocked down, Gepard's HP immediately restores to {{scaling}}% of his Max HP. This effect can only trigger once per battle.

technique.name: Comradery
technique.description: After Gepard uses his Technique, when the next battle begins, a Shield will be applied to all allies, absorbing DMG equal to 24% of Gepard's DEF plus 150 for 2 turn(s).

2.name: Integrity
2.description: Gepard has a higher chance to be attacked by enemies.

4.name: Commander
4.description: When "Unyielding Will" is triggered, Gepard's Energy will be restored to 100%.

6.name: Grit
6.description: Gepard's ATK increases by 35% of his current DEF. This effect will refresh at the start of each turn.

eidolons.name: Due Diligence
eidolons.description: When using Skill, increases the base chance to Freeze the attacked target enemy by 35%.

eidolons.name: Lingering Cold
eidolons.description: After an enemy Frozen by Skill is unfrozen, their SPD is reduced by 20% for 1 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Never Surrender
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Faith Moves Mountains
eidolons.description: When Gepard is in battle, all allies' Effect RES increases by 20%.

eidolons.name: Cold Iron Fist
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Unyielding Resolve
eidolons.description: When his Talent is triggered, Gepard immediately takes action and restores extra HP equal to 50% of his Max HP.
